strategies.name: liquidity_grab_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: Look for price to break a support or resistance, fake out, and reverse; specifically enter at the candle that made the liquidity grab. For longs, the candle that swept support becomes the entry reference; for shorts, the candle that swept resistance becomes the entry reference.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the liquidity grab and take profit at the next recent swing high/low, aiming to capture the impulsive reversal move.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: enter at the candle that made the buy-side liquidity grab after the fakeout breaks support/resistance and reverses
variants.target_note: take profit at a recent high
variants.transcript_quote: your long entry would be at this point right here because this candle made this liquidity grab

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: enter at the candle that made the sell-side liquidity grab after the fakeout breaks support/resistance and reverses
variants.target_note: take profit at a recent low
variants.transcript_quote: your short entry would be at the bottom of this candle that initiated this liquidity grab

strategies.name: liquidity_grab_reversal_with_divergence_and_htf_location_filters
strategies.entry_summary: Use the same liquidity-grab reversal entry, but only take it when it occurs at a higher-timeframe support or resistance and is reinforced by momentum divergence. The transcript frames these as filters/confluence to improve the same base reversal entry.
strategies.exit_summary: Use the same stop beyond the liquidity grab and the same swing-based take profit; the added divergence and higher-timeframe context are entry-quality filters, not a different exit model.

variants.variant_label: daily/HTF-proximate liquidity grab with divergence confluence
variants.timeframe_note: lower timeframe entry filtered by higher timeframe support/resistance
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: require momentum divergence alongside the liquidity grab
variants.target_note: same recent high/low take-profit logic as base reversal
variants.transcript_quote: we combine both the powers of the Divergence and the bullish liquidity grab and it gives us a higher probability of working in our favor

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: only take the lower-timeframe liquidity grab if the signal sits at higher-timeframe support or resistance
variants.target_note: same 15-minute stop loss and take profit structure
variants.transcript_quote: we then move to a 1hour time frame and we see this Buy Signal signal happened exactly at a support on a higher time frame

enumeration_note: One base liquidity-grab reversal is taught, then the same skeleton is improved with divergence and higher-timeframe location filters; these are compatible variants rather than separate opposing strategies.
